title: AIR-DS fleet policy (fleet-policy.json)
description: Policy-as-code for one repo, committed at <repoRoot>/fleet-policy.json and enforced deterministically by `ds-fleet policy-check` (and, via its API, by the validation gauntlet). Every knob is optional; only declared knobs are checked. Verdicts are computed from the repo's committed metrics/history.jsonl and config — no network, no LLM.

tokenOverrides.description: Governs semantic-tier token overrides, discovered from <repoRoot>/brands/*.semantic.json (flattened to canonical dot-form names; "--ds-color-text-link" == "color.text.link").

semanticTier.description: "forbidden": any semantic-tier override breaches. "allowlist": overrides outside `allowlist` breach.

allowlist.description: Canonical semantic token names a customer may override when semanticTier is "allowlist".

minEvalCritical.description: Latest recorded eval critical pass rate must be >= this (typically 1.0). Breaches when no eval run is recorded.

minFirstPass.description: First-pass gauntlet rate over the repo's full recorded history (passed runs / total runs) must be >= this. Breaches when no gauntlet run is recorded.

requiredGauntletSteps.description: Step names that must all appear in the latest recorded gauntlet run (e.g. ["typecheck", "lint", "build", "test", "registry-check"]).

browserAxe.description: "required": the latest stories-axe recording must exist and its serious/critical gate must have passed. "optional": not checked.

maxFabrications.description: Latest snapshot fabrication count (G1/G5 closed-world hits) must be <= this. Typically 0. Not checked when omitted.
